title: Create BEV C03 Thermal System Knowledge Assessment with Scenario-Based Diagnostics
description: Create a comprehensive Knowledge Assessment document for BEV C03 (Thermal Management Systems) with scenario-based questions that require learners to diagnose and troubleshoot thermal cooling system failures, aligned with CoCU learning outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create KA.md file with minimum 8 scenario-based questions covering thermal system diagnostics, with each scenario including system state, symptoms, and required diagnosis
Include answer scheme with marking rubric (1-4 points per question) based on CoCU assessment criteria
Ensure 30% of questions test theoretical knowledge and 70% test practical diagnostic scenarios

title: Create Aesthetic C01 Performance Assessment with Bilingual Client Consultation Evaluation Rubric
description: Develop a Performance Assessment document for Aesthetic C01 (Client Consultation) with detailed evaluation rubrics in English and Malay, enabling assessors to evaluate learner competency in professional client interaction, needs analysis, and treatment planning.
acceptanceCriteria: Create PA.md file with evaluation rubrics for minimum 4 key competencies (professional communication, listening, needs analysis, treatment recommendation) with 5-point scale
Include bilingual rubric descriptors (EN/BM) for each competency level with consistent terminology across all rubrics
Provide sample assessment scenario with completed rubric example demonstrating how to score learner performance
technicalNotes: Validation: grep -c "BM:" aesthetic-services/C01-client-consultation/PA.md (should be >= 20 for bilingual consistency)

title: Create IT-020-3 System Security Knowledge Points and Assessment for C01
description: Develop Knowledge Point documents for IT-020 Level 3, Competency Unit C01 (System Security Fundamentals), covering authentication, access control, and encryption, with corresponding Assignment Sheet and Knowledge Assessment aligned with NOSS CoCU.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 3 KP files (KP-01: User Authentication, KP-02: Access Control, KP-03: Encryption Basics) with technical depth and practical examples from industry standards
Create KT assignment sheet (KT-01) with 4 questions testing knowledge from all 3 KPs with answer schemes
Create KA knowledge assessment with minimum 8 questions covering system security fundamentals with marking rubric and answer schemes
